༄༅/ /sa bdag lto 'phye chen po brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa nyes pa kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sa bdag lto 'phye chen po brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa nyes pa kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis mthong thos dran pas kyang*// mi shes mun pa rnams 'joms pa'i// 'jam mgon dge ba'i bshes de nyid// rtag tu bdag gi bla mar bsten// dam pa dang po'i rtsa rgyud las// sa yi dgra can zhes gsungs shing*// de yi 'grel chen rnams su yang*// drag po zhes ni ming du brjod// rgyud gzhan rnams su lto 'phye zhes// lha khang mchod rten khang bzang dang*// rab gnas dbang bskur sbyin sreg sogs// kun la gces pa'i man ngag 'di// 'phyug med lag len go bde bar// kho bos bshad kyi shes ldan dag /yod na gcom bskyungs dga' bas longs// gang du bya ba'i sa phyogs der// brkyang nul me long ngos ltar bya// de steng shar nub tshangs thig gdab// dbus tshad bzung la shar nub tu// 'tsham pa'i mtshan ma re re bya// mtshan ma gnyis kyi steng nas rim// lho byang bya rog rjes su bri// rgya gram steng du lho byang gi// tshangs thig gnyis pa btab pa'i ngos// lho byang sngar tshad mtshan ma btab| |mtshan ma bzhi steng nas rim bzhin// me srin rlung dbang so so ru// bya rjes byas te zur thig btab// sa phyogs yangs dog go skabs dang*| |bstun bya'i rgya tshad shar nub kyi// tshangs thig steng du mtshan ma bya// tshad de tshangs steng nas bzung la// zur thig steng du mtshan ma bri// de dag sbrel bas ngos bzhi'i thig |gzhung du klu yi rgyal po yi// lus tshad mtho bcu gsungs pa'i don// cha chen grangs yin mtho dngos min// de phyir tshangs las g.yas g.yon du// snyoms pa'i mtshan ma lnga lnga bya| |so sor thig btab ngos re rer// cha chen bcu 'byung slar cha chen// re re'ang cha phran dgu dgur dbye// des ni re'u mig kun bsdom par// brgyad stong brgya phrag gcig 'byung ngo| |phyi yi ngos rer re'u mig ni// dgu bcu dgu bcu 'byung ba yin// zhag grangs sum brgya drug cu tshang*// de yang rags pa'i gnas lugs la// dgun gsum mgo shar kha lhor blta| |dpyid gsum mgo lho kha nub blta// dbyar gsum mgo nub kha byang blta// ston gsum mgo byang kha shar blta// la lar dgun gsum mgo bo lho// dpyid gsum mgo nub dbyar gsum la// mgo byang ston gsum mgo shar zhes// 'byung ngo gzhan yang dpyid ra sogs// ngos 'dzin dus kyi 'khor lo dang*// rgya nag gsar rnying la sogs pa// tha dad lugs mang ngal ba'i rgyu// slob dpon gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba// yin na hor zla bcu gnyis pa// dpyid ra stag yin slob dpon de// gsang sngags phyi 'gyur la mos na// dpyid ra dbo zla nya khyim bzung*// lugs gzhan chu la mar bzhin no// blta phyogs rang lugs rnam dag ni// dpyid gsum mgo nub kha byang bstan// dbyar gsum mgo byang kha shar blta// ston gsum mgo shar kha lhor bstan// dgun gsum mgo lho kha nub blta// de yang dpyid dus mgo nub bstan// mjug ma shar phyogs kun la 'gre// tha chung bzhi yi gnam stong dang*// ra ba bzhi yi tshes gcig la// zur thig g.yas g.yon cha phran steng*// 'bring bzhi'i bco lnga bcu drug la// tshangs thig bzhi yi g.yas g.yon gyi// cha phran steng gnas de kho nar// nyin zhag re la re'u mig re// spyod cing g.yas su 'khor bar byed// de ltar gnas pa'i lus tshad dang*// dngos grub sa dmigs mi shes par// gang byung cho rol bgyis pa na// 'di ni shin tu gnyan pa ste// mthong dang reg bsam kha rlangs sogs// dug lnga ldan zhing klu sa bdag
/kun gyi rgyal po lha dang gnyan// gza' dang sde brgyad yongs
